meta.sources: SEC EDGAR only: companyfacts XBRL + 10-K/10-Q/20-F/6-K/S-1 filings (accession numbers per figure). No figure invented.
conventions: EBITDA = operating income + depreciation & amortisation; where a company reports adjusted EBITDA the reported figure is given and flagged.
FCF = operating cash flow - capital expenditures (purchases of property and equipment).
DSCR = operating cash flow / (cash interest paid + principal repaid). OCF already reflects cash interest and taxes, so interest is not subtracted twice.
Total debt = short-term debt + current portion of long-term debt + long-term debt (non-current), balance-sheet carrying amounts, unless noted. Net debt = total debt - cash and equivalents.
Gross raised = sum of amount_usd_b for include_in_total rows in ai-debt.json for that issue year (prevents parent/subsidiary double counting).
WA yield on new issues = amount-weighted average yield_or_coupon_pct across that year's included raises with a non-null yield.
WA interest rate on existing debt = debt-note disclosed WA rate where given, otherwise blended effective rate = interest expense / average total debt; method stated per row (wa_rate_method).

Forward 2027-2028: disclosed maturities are principal from the latest 10-K/20-F/S-1 maturity schedule; estimated refinancing = disclosed maturities (assumption: all maturing principal is refinanced); forecast new borrowing is null for every company (no disclosed borrowing plan); projected closing debt = opening debt under the refinance assumption.

Anthropic debt: carrying value is convertible notes at FAIR VALUE; principal outstanding is far lower (~$7.35B FY2025 / ~$6.2B TTM). Debt-service math uses PRINCIPAL, and the fair-value carrying amount is shown separately. Interest expense is UNAVAILABLE (no interest line; coupons are PIK/payable at maturity).
TTM = latest fiscal year + latest interim period - prior-year interim period, from the filed statements.

YEAR CONVENTION — READ BEFORE CHARTING: v1 annual_chart uses CALENDAR years (issue month in ai-debt.json); the new annual_profile uses FISCAL years (the company reporting period). For companies with non-December fiscal year-ends (Microsoft Jun, NVIDIA Jan, Oracle May, Broadcom Oct/Nov) the same offering can appear in different year buckets — e.g. Microsoft $25B Oct 2026 is calendar-2026 in v1 but FY2027 in annual_profile; NVIDIA $5B Jun 2021 is calendar-2021 in v1 but FY2022 in annual_profile. Never mix the two series in one chart without relabelling the year basis.
structural_notes: annual_profile shapes differ by research group and are kept verbatim: megacap and oracle groups use a flat list of rows (FY2021-2026 + TTM row); infra group uses {"rows": [...], "ttm": {...}}.

oracle group annual_profile rows carry borrowing_composition as a nested dict; megacap rows carry flat bonds_usd_b / bank_borrowings_usd_b / commercial_paper_usd_b / other_borrowings_usd_b; infra TTM rows carry borrowing_composition_usd_b.
warning_flags shapes differ by group (kept verbatim); warning_flags_summary normalises the four flags to {flag: true|false|null, detail: string} per company.

maturity_ladder shapes differ by group (kept verbatim); every ladder carries its schedule date, source accession, principal maturing by year, cumulative % of total debt, largest maturity year, largest single instrument, committed facilities, cash + facilities, unfunded 12M maturities and the 24M refinancing gap.

conventions: Total debt = short-term debt + current portion of long-term debt + long-term debt (non-current), balance-sheet carrying amounts, unless noted.

FCF = operating cash flow - capital expenditures (purchases of property and equipment). For Hut 8, capex = purchases of property and equipment + deposits paid to purchase miners/mining equipment (matches the existing dataset FY2025 0.217); deposits for future sites excluded.
EBITDA (task definition) = operating income + depreciation & amortisation. Where the company reports Adjusted EBITDA, the reported figure is given in the row notes for comparison.

Gross raised = sum of amount_usd_b for include_in_total rows in ai-debt.json for that issue year (prevents parent/subsidiary double counting). Borrowing composition (bonds / bank borrowings / commercial paper / other) is classified from ai-debt.json instrument_type: bonds = senior notes / convertible (senior) notes / senior secured notes / unsecured convertible loan notes / secured subordinated convertible notes; bank borrowings = credit facility / term loan / DDTL / construction loan / project financing / syndicated / equipment financing / revolving; commercial paper = none for these 5 companies; other = SAFE, related-party loan, equipment lease financing, promissory note, undocumented facilities. Bank borrowings in the raises file reflect facility commitments/originations, not drawn cash.

Net borrowing = gross raised - principal repaid (cash-flow statement "repayments of debt" line). Where gross raised reflects facility commitments rather than draws, net borrowing overstates cash borrowing - noted per row.

WA interest rate on existing debt: debt-note disclosed WA rate if given, otherwise blended effective rate = interest expense / average total debt (or year-end total debt where the average is unavailable); method stated per row.
DSCR = OCF / (cash interest paid + principal repaid); OCF already reflects cash interest and taxes, so interest is not subtracted twice.

Maturity ladder: principal maturing per calendar year from the latest filed maturity schedule (10-Q where more current than the latest 10-K); 12M maturities = balance-sheet current portion; 24M/3Y = calendar buckets; thereafter = post-2031 principal unless the schedule splits it.

Unfunded maturities 12M = max(0, 12M maturities - cash - committed facilities); refinancing gap 24M = max(0, 24M maturities - cash - committed facilities). Cash is unrestricted cash and equivalents only; restricted cash is excluded and flagged separately.
TTM = latest FY + latest interim period - prior-year interim period, from filed statements.
